Source: `catalog/services/*.yaml` (schema `catalog/schemas/service.schema.json`), facts verified 2026-10-09 against Microsoft Learn, docs.datadoghq.com and the azurerm 5.9.0 / azapi 2.13.0 provider schemas. Signals column: M = platform/app metrics, L = logs, T = traces, RUM = browser RUM, Prof = profiling (yes / partial / no / - = not applicable). DBM = Datadog Database Monitoring for that exact hosting variant. Cost is an approximate list-price estimate at lab defaults (see each entry's `cost.assumptions`).

| Synapse Data Explorer (retired) (`synapse-data-explorer`) | retired | 2025-10-07 |  | data-explorer | Data Explorer (Kusto) pools in Synapse retired 2025-10-07 (preview never GA). |
| Azure Cache for Redis (legacy) (`azure-cache-for-redis`) | retiring | 2028-09-30 | 2026-04-01 | managed-redis | All SKUs retiring. Basic/Standard/Premium (public cloud): creation blocked for NEW customers from 2026-04-01 (a tenant is 'existing' if any subscription had a cache before 2026-04-01); the planned Oct-2026 block for existing customers was removed (July 2026 update) so existing tenants can create caches until retirement on 2028-09-30. Enterprise/Enterprise Flash: creation blocked 2026-04-01, remaining caches migrated to Azure Managed Redis on 2027-03-31. Not a lab default. |
| Azure Cloud Services (extended support) (`cloud-services-extended-support`) | retiring | 2027-03-31 |  | service-fabric-managed | Deprecated since 2025-03-31; fully retired 2027-03-31 with no extensions. Migrate to Service Fabric managed clusters. |
| Azure Functions Consumption (Linux, retiring) (`functions-consumption-linux`) | retiring | 2028-09-30 |  | functions-flex-consumption | Linux Consumption hosting retires 2028-09-30; no new features or language versions (Python 3.12 is the last; 3.13 unsupported). v3 runtime apps on Linux Consumption stop after 2026-09-30. Migrate to Flex Consumption. |
| Azure Spring Apps (`spring-apps`) | retiring | 2028-03-31 | 2025-03-17 | container-apps-consumption | Retirement period started 2025-03-17 (no new customers); all plans retire 2028-03-31. Migrate to Container Apps or AKS. Tanzu components (App Live View, App Accelerator, ACS) out of support since 2025-08-31. |
| Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL (`cosmos-postgresql`) | not-recommended |  |  | postgresql-elastic-cluster | On a retirement path and no longer recommended for new projects (product-updates page); use PostgreSQL elastic clusters (or Cosmos DB for NoSQL). No retirement date published. |
| Azure Functions Consumption (Windows, legacy) (`functions-consumption-windows`) | legacy |  |  |  | Consumption plan is documented as legacy; Windows Consumption is not affected by the Linux retirement and remains the only serverless Windows option. Python is not supported on Windows. |
| Azure HorizonDB (preview) (`horizondb`) | preview |  |  |  | Public preview. Docs list no access form for the base service (only AI Model Management is a gated limited preview), but availability 'depends on your Azure subscription and region'. PostgreSQL 17 only; 7-day backup retention; no CMK, no VNet injection (private link only), no cross-region replicas, no PgBouncer. |
